items.qa_observation: Machine controls and dispensing bay read; glossy product-render appearance, and alpha bounds touch top/left edges. iso2x uncalibrated.

items.qa_observation: Hand truck and loaded crates are identifiable, but crates obscure the frame and wheel; sprite touches bottom canvas edge; glossy style and iso2x are unverified.

items.qa_observation: Three open lattice crates read clearly and are not solid cubes; low-alpha blue fringe extends beyond primary silhouette, cool saturated glossy highlights, strict iso2x uncalibrated.

items.subject: freestanding A-frame hot-snack promo sign with abstract fried-food illustration
items.qa_observation: true RGBA alpha and complete silhouette; warm palette fits. Sign face is strongly perspective-oblique rather than verified iso2x, and no in-game scale/anchor calibration has been done. Review-only.

items.subject: Japanese convenience-store ATM candidate v2
items.qa_observation: True RGBA transparency and readable ATM controls/red side housing. The machine has a strongly perspective-like view and does not satisfy strict iso2x axis calibration; edge fringe and world scale/anchor remain unverified.

items.subject: A-frame promotional sign, warm painted candidate (subagent generated)
items.qa_observation: A-frame form and abstract sandwich illustration are readable in a warm painted style. True RGBA transparency is present, though low-alpha fringe reaches top edge; perspective face is not calibrated to iso2x_v1.

items.subject: nested blue convenience-store shopping baskets on wheeled cart
items.qa_observation: Three nested perforated shopping baskets on a caster base are unmistakable, with true RGBA transparency. Some blue fringe reaches the left edge; camera is strongly perspective-like and highlights are too glossy for strict iso2x/game style. Review-only.

items.subject: three stacked reusable delivery crates, transparent retry v3
items.qa_observation: Three open lattice crates with readable rims and interiors; muted matte blue improved relative to v2, but diffuse blue alpha haze still surrounds the silhouette (alpha>=1 bbox is much wider than alpha>=8 bbox). The camera still appears perspective-like rather than calibrated iso2x; review-only.

items.subject: compact checkout POS terminal with touchscreen/keypad/receipt printer
items.qa_observation: Touchscreen, keypad and receipt printer are clearly readable as one compact POS station; genuine RGBA transparency with low-alpha haze around silhouette. Camera is strongly perspective-oblique rather than verified iso2x_v1, and glossy highlights exceed target game style. Review-only.

items.subject: two-compartment convenience-store recycling bin candidate
items.qa_observation: Two apertures and recycling pictograms are readable; true alpha with margin. Glossy, perspective-like geometry; exact iso2x projection and in-game scale are unverified.

items.subject: umbrella stand with three closed umbrellas and drip tray
items.qa_observation: Complete warm hand-painted umbrella stand; true alpha and clear margin. Faint red/green edge fringe; game projection and scale remain uncalibrated.

items.subject: ATM projection-only edit v3
items.qa_observation: ATM controls, red side panels and silhouette remain readable after a projection-only edit. Camera still looks perspective-like rather than calibrated iso2x_v1; nonzero alpha reaches left and bottom canvas edges, so framing/edge QA fails. Keep original and this revision as separate review-only candidates.
